title: Program Material Analyst
description:
Program Materials Analyst 1 Year+ Contract (Remote)

The Program Analyst within the Program Delivery team will work Closely with the LTIPP (Long Term Infrastructure Improvement Plan) team providing solid analyst in the materials management space. The analyst will work with supply chain, line and substation engineering and project management to ensure success within the LTIIP Program, this role will be responsible for but not limited to:
  • Work with engineering, major equipment and consulting company on Demand Planning and forecasting exercise across LTIIP program
  • Work closely with Engineering, Program Managers, Supply Chain Management and construction to ensure materials are procured on time to meet project objectives
  • Lead meetings with key stakeholders to provide program updates on materials delivery status
  • Participate in quarterly business reviews to track vendor progress
  • Manage long lead time items through effective tracking and monitoring utilizes key performance indicators
  • Provide weekly status reports as an input to directors' presentations socializing status
  • Provide regular updates to key stakeholders of material deliveries, risk mitigation strategies and contingency plans related to materials management
  • Lead/participate in materials initiative to drive efficiency for LTIIP
  • Work closely with the Materials Program Manager identifying and recommending process improvements
  • Participating in weekly calls with the Materials Program Manager to gain alignment on strategies related to materials
